title: PagerArchive agency profile
description: One agency's page formats (SPEC.md section 6.4, ADR 0001 section 2). Formats are tried in order on the redacted text with the priority marker removed.

labels.description: Display labels per field: field name to (code to label). Display only (P3).

large_event_fields.description: Field values that open a large event (R87): an Emergency page to an aliased capcode whose field holds one of the listed values opens or joins one, as a page with a code does. Values are compared exactly, as extracted (P3).

field.description: A text field one of the formats extracts: a named group, or an address_split output.

values.description: The values that open a large event, each listed: any other value, or none, doesn't.

priorities.description: Priorities this format applies to. Omitted: every priority, including none.

match.description: RE2 regular expression. Named groups become fields; groups starting with _ are intermediate. Empty matches everything (text-only format).

fields.description: Post-processing for captured groups, keyed by group name.

split.description: RE2 pattern that splits the value into a list. Elements are trimmed; empty ones are dropped. An empty pattern splits into single characters.

address_split.description: Splits the value at the longest suffix that is [house number] <street> <locality> from the address dataset.
